Since there isn't a 1911 builders sub, this seemed the most appropriate subverse. Hope it helps put a few more guns into the world. If I left out any sources of good quality parts, leave a comment and I'll add it. Probably.

Frames

  • Caspian sells blems under their Foster brand, which is very well regarded.
  • For 80%, there aren't any reliable deals out there. Sometimes the 80% sources sell blems at a discount. If you're really cheap, go to Sarco for a grey market RIA.

Slides

  • Remsport 'Deal of the Day' often has bald 45 slides for around $100

Barrels

  • Heavy Armor Division has what are most likely Remsport barrels with link and bushing for $85 shipped. The website is not secured, so don't enter your cc info. Mail, phone, or email for other options. Some of their stuff is also on ebay.
  • Remsport direct has 5" barrels for $77, or $97 with link and bushing, shipped
  • Swenson, like Roto, are around $50, but are not recommended

Guts

  • Klonimus sells trigger warning parts, some injection molded, some machined - check the descriptions

Tools

  • Otto Frei sells a good selection of files at fair prices

Services

  • Freedom Gun Works, aka CK Arms is reasonable for sight cuts or other slide or barrel work
  • RSM looks like good pricing for cerakote

Tips

  • Brownells carries quite a bit and there are three ways of getting discounts, all of which can be combined: Coupons, C&R, and ActiveJunky rebate. They can also special order some things, but it's a long and annoying ordeal.
  • Armscor and Para stuff can always be had more cheaply. You can get that stuff from ebay or a million other sources, all around the same price.
